flash_bytes.reason: +1,072 B over the 4,060,720 B ceiling recorded at 03d259f1: #168 (NEWT-212, slice 1) teaches the page-cache reader the v4 segment format with an optional resume-point range. The reader decides the point's owning page once at open (PageCacheReader::point_owner, 340 B), rejects a v4 page gap outside the page data or overlapping another gap, ends the owner at the point and makes any other page the range touches miss (page_extent, 216 B), parses the v4 footer (open_allocated 1,262 -> 1,416 B) and requires a v4 page record to fill its extent exactly (decode_page 1,592 -> 1,744 B); u32_at is no longer inlined (+140 B) and two callers grow by 12 B. An nm diff of the two clean ELFs gives +1,014 B of code; Flash Data grows 48 B. Control: a clean build of 75032428 (main without the change) measures 4,060,720 B. Clean regional DEV USB build with the pinned Python at c75104d4: 4,061,792 B. Static RAM 124,096 -> 124,096 B (+0 B), RTC 300 -> 300 B (+0 B), lent Wi-Fi RAM 22,528 -> 22,528 B (+0 B), selected stacks unchanged (open_selected_profile 480 <= 656 B). Unselected stack frames grow: PageCacheReader::open_allocated 144 -> 176 B, PhasedChapterCache::read_entry 496 -> 512 B and Resources::stored 464 -> 480 B (from each function's prologue); point_owner, page_extent and u32_at are leaves with no frame. Single frames do not establish the runtime stack peak; no stack ceiling or memory floor moves. Usable app space 7,016,448 B; headroom 2,955,728 B (42.13%) -> 2,954,656 B (42.11%). The writer still emits v3, so no card use changes.
